ocean3.label: OCEAN QUIZ
ocean3.intro: Ocean quiz! Three questions. Can you get all three?

items.q: What is the largest fish in the sea?
items.say: Whale shark! The blue whale is bigger, but it's a mammal, not a fish.

items.q: How do dolphins sleep?
items.say: One eye open! Half of their brain stays awake.

items.q: What is a baby whale called?
items.say: A calf! Just like a baby cow.

birds5.label: BIRD QUIZ
birds5.intro: Bird quiz! Five questions, three seconds each. Go!

items.q: Which bird can fly backwards?
items.f: It can hover in place too!
items.say: Hummingbird!

items.q: Which bird lays the biggest egg?
items.f: Biggest egg of any living bird!
items.say: Ostrich!

items.q: Which bird can turn its head the furthest?
items.say: Owl! Up to two hundred seventy degrees.

items.q: Which bird has the widest wingspan?
items.say: The wandering albatross!

items.q: Which bird can sleep while flying?
items.f: A few seconds at a time!
items.say: The frigatebird! It naps in short bursts, mid-air.

bugs.label: BUG QUIZ
bugs.intro: Bug quiz! Three questions. Can you get all three?

items.q: How do ants breathe?
items.say: Tiny holes in their sides! Ants don't have lungs.

items.q: How long can a cockroach live without its head?
items.f: It dies because it can't drink
items.say: About a week! It finally dies because it can't drink water.

items.q: Which hunter catches its prey most often?
items.f: Up to 95% of its hunts succeed
items.say: The dragonfly! Up to ninety five percent of its hunts succeed.

food3.label: FOOD QUIZ
food3.intro: Food quiz! Three questions. The last one is the trickiest.

items.q: Which of these is a berry?
items.say: Banana! Scientists call it a berry. Strawberries and raspberries are not true berries.

items.q: Where were potatoes first grown?
items.say: South America! They were first grown in the Andes mountains.

items.q: Which food can stay good for centuries if sealed?
items.say: Honey! Pots of honey were found in ancient Egyptian tombs.

geo5.label: WORLD QUIZ
geo5.intro: World quiz! Five questions, three seconds each. Go!

items.q: What is the largest ocean?
items.say: The Pacific!

items.q: Which continent has the most countries?
items.say: Africa! Fifty four countries.

items.q: Which country has the most people?
items.say: India!

items.q: What is the smallest country in the world?
items.say: Vatican City!

items.q: What is the largest desert on Earth?
items.f: A desert = very little rain or snow!
items.say: Antarctica! A desert is any place with very little rain or snow.

animals2.label: ANIMAL QUIZ
animals2.intro: Animal quiz! Three questions. Can you get all three?

items.q: Which animal has fingerprints almost like ours?
items.say: Koala! Their fingerprints look almost exactly like ours, even under a microscope.

items.q: Which animal can't jump?
items.f: One foot always stays on the ground
items.say: Elephant! Even when it runs, at least one foot stays on the ground.

items.q: What does a hippo's red 'sweat' do?
items.say: It works like sunscreen! Hippo skin oozes a reddish liquid that protects it from the sun.

kids2.label: ANIMAL QUIZ
kids2.intro: Kids versus parents! Three animal questions. Who gets all three?

items.q: What do pandas eat most?
items.f: They eat for 10+ hours a day!
items.say: Bamboo! They spend more than ten hours a day eating.

items.q: Which big cat can't roar?
items.say: The cheetah! It purrs and chirps instead.

items.q: Which of these is NOT a bear?
items.say: The koala! It's a marsupial, like a kangaroo.

dino5.label: DINO QUIZ
dino5.intro: Dinosaur quiz! Five questions, three seconds each. Go!

items.q: Which dinosaur had three horns?
items.say: Triceratops!

items.q: Which dinosaur had plates on its back?
items.say: Stegosaurus!

items.q: What does the word dinosaur mean?
items.say: Terrible lizard!

items.q: What wiped out most dinosaurs?
items.say: An asteroid!

items.q: Which animals alive today are dinosaurs?
items.say: Birds! Scientists count birds as living dinosaurs.

oceanfacts.label: OCEAN QUIZ
oceanfacts.intro: Ocean quiz, round two! Three questions. Can you get all three?

items.q: Which shark can glow in the dark?
items.say: Lanternshark! It makes its own light, deep in the ocean.

items.q: Which animal has the densest fur?
items.f: Up to a million hairs per square inch
items.say: Sea otter! Up to a million hairs per square inch.

items.q: How much of Earth's oxygen is made in the ocean?
items.say: At least half! Tiny drifting plankton make it.

science3.label: SCIENCE QUIZ
science3.intro: Science quiz! Three questions. The last one surprises everyone.

items.q: What is the center of an atom called?
items.say: The nucleus!

items.q: Which is faster?
items.say: Light! It's nearly a million times faster than sound.

items.q: What color is a sunset on Mars?
items.say: Blue! Dust on Mars makes its sunsets look blue.

babies5.label: BABY ANIMALS
babies5.intro: Baby animal quiz! Five questions, three seconds each. Go!

items.q: What is a baby kangaroo called?
items.say: A joey!

items.q: What is a baby horse called?
items.say: A foal!

items.q: What is a baby frog called?
items.f: It starts life with a tail!
items.say: A tadpole!

items.q: What is a baby swan called?
items.f: A gosling is a baby goose!
items.say: A cygnet!

items.q: What is a baby hedgehog called?
items.say: A hoglet!

kids1.label: ANIMAL QUIZ
kids1.intro: Kids versus parents! Three animal questions. Who gets all three?

items.q: Which animal laughs when you tickle it?
items.f: Rats squeak with joy when tickled!
items.say: The rat! Scientists found rats make happy squeaks when they're tickled.

items.q: Which animal has striped skin, not just striped fur?
items.say: The tiger! Its skin is striped too, not just its fur.

items.q: What is the tallest animal in the world?
items.say: The giraffe! Up to about five and a half meters tall.

groups3.label: ANIMAL GROUPS
groups3.intro: Animal group names! Three questions. Can you get all three?

items.q: What is a group of crows famously called?
items.say: A murder! A murder of crows.

items.q: What is a group of owls called?
items.say: A parliament! A parliament of owls.

items.q: What is a group of flamingos called?
items.say: A flamboyance! The perfect name for flamingos.

space3.label: SPACE QUIZ
space3.intro: Space quiz! Three questions. Can you get all three?

items.q: Which is longer on Venus?
items.f: A day there is 243 Earth days
items.say: A day! Venus takes about two hundred forty three Earth days to spin once, but only two hundred twenty five to circle the Sun.

items.q: How long could footprints on the Moon last?
items.f: No wind or rain to wipe them away
items.say: Millions of years! There's no wind or rain to wipe them away.

items.q: How old is the sunlight you see?
items.f: It left the Sun 8 minutes ago
items.say: About eight minutes! That's how long it takes to get here from the Sun.

eyes.label: EYE QUIZ
eyes.intro: Eye quiz! Three questions about your own eyes. Can you get all three?

items.q: Where does the clear front of your eye get its oxygen?
items.f: The cornea has no blood vessels
items.say: Straight from the air! The clear front of your eye, the cornea, has no blood vessels.

items.q: Why don't you notice your eye's blind spot?
items.f: It's where the nerve leaves the eye
items.say: Your brain fills in the gap! Each eye has a blind spot where the nerve leaves it.

items.q: How is the picture on the back of your eye?
items.say: Upside down! Your brain flips it the right way up.

cats.label: CAT QUIZ
cats.intro: Cat quiz! Three questions. Can you get all three?

items.q: Which taste can't cats taste?
items.f: They lack the sweet taste gene
items.say: Sweet! Cats are missing the gene for sweet taste.

items.q: Who do adult cats meow at the most?
items.say: People! Grown-up cats hardly ever meow at other cats.

items.q: How many eyelids does each cat eye have?
items.f: A hidden one protects the eye
items.say: Three! A thin, hidden third eyelid sweeps across to protect the eye.
